## Overview

This project focused on developing control policies for a linear chain of underwater robots (inspired by salp chains) to achieve coordinated obstacle avoidance navigation.

## Key Contributions

- **Developed a control policy** for a linear chain of underwater robots for coordinated obstacle avoidance navigation.
- Worked with a **2D underwater navigation** RL environment with salp chain agents from GRASP Lab, UPenn.
- Implemented **multi-agent policies** IQL, MAPPO, and MADDPG for target navigation and obstacle avoidance.
- Designed **dynamic underwater obstacle-placement curriculum**, achieving an **81%** collision-free navigation success rate.
